from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = next(x for x in counts if x != background)
    return [[foreground if x == background else 0 for x in row] for row in grid]
